input.title: Unisex Coding – It Works. I'm Scared. Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

IT WORKS. I'M SCARED. is the coding hoodie for the developer whose code runs and who dares not touch it again, worn at the desk, on late-night deploys and as a gift from a team that has lived through one.

IT WORKS. runs across the top in tall condensed capitals and I'M SCARED. fills the bottom, even wider. Between them a raccoon in big round glasses sits at a chunky old computer terminal with its paws raised off the keyboard, wide-eyed, beside three stacked empty coffee mugs and a glowing desk lamp.

Navy carries cream and terminal green lettering with a cream edge around the desk scene; Sand gets deep brown and forest green lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this coding hoodie warm enough for late nights at the desk and cold offices?
Yes. The It Works. I'm Scared. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for late nights at the desk, cold offices and long deploy days.

How does the It Works. I'm Scared. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt or base layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for a programmer?
It is a natural one. Every programmer has shipped something that works and prayed nobody touches it, so it lands with developers, sysadmins and the teammates on the same deploy. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the desk scene sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the It Works. I'm Scared. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
